tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various encodings and provides detailed errors. Use head/tail parameters.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with new content. Operates within allowed dirs.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Perform line-based edits to a text file and return a git-style diff.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Ensure a directory exists, creating parent directories as needed.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories at a path, marking types.

tools.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tools.description: Like list_directory but include sizes, with optional sorting.

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Return JSON tree of directories/files recursively.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory within allowed paths.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search using glob patterns starting at path.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about a file or directory.

tools.name: run_cargo
tools.description: Run an allowed cargo subcommand (build, test, check) in the workspace root.

tools.name: read_netlist
tools.description: Read and parse a JSON netlist or IR file.

tools.name: run_simulator
tools.description: Run a local simulator binary inside the workspace.

tools.name: estimate_resources
tools.description: Estimate hardware resources (LUTs, Regs) from a JSON netlist.

tools.name: parity_check
tools.description: Compare two files (expected vs actual) and return detailed diff if different.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Return directories the server may access according to config.
